outcome_variable_scope: Per (rater, prompt) disagreement between the rater's own `world` ranking and the compiled rule at equal weights, decomposed as mu + gamma_prompt + alpha_rater + eps, per compiler capacity. No judge call and no new measurement -- r04's satisfaction tensors taken as given.
scope: Rater MAIN EFFECT only. No within-cell replication exists, so the rater-by-prompt interaction is inseparable from error and test-retest reliability is unidentified. Presentation order is not recorded anywhere in the release, so a position confound cannot be ruled out by any analysis of this data.
verdict: B STRUCTURED. The one-way decomposition showed compilation dropping the case-shared share of rater-versus-rule error from rho 0.3591 to 0.2843, of which the navigator established 86% is the CASE term collapsing and only 14% the idiosyncratic term rising -- and a one-way model cannot tell an idiosyncratic rise attached to PARTICULAR PEOPLE from unstructured noise. Adding a crossed rater main effect on the same 15,202 cells, 1012 raters over 968 prompts: var_rater is 0.00422 for full and 0.00626 for core, 9.4% and 13.7% of residual variance, against a within-prompt shuffle floor of 0.00375 and 0.00392. Delta_var_rater = +0.00204, 95% CI over prompts [+0.00133,+0.00302]. AND THE CONTROL THAT COULD HAVE MADE THIS AN ARTIFACT: capping full's criteria at core's count varies aggregation coarseness with compilation ABSENT. Across caps of 4, 6 and 8 plus uncapped, full's var_rater stays in [0.00407,0.00427] -- a band 0.00020 wide -- while core sits +0.00200 above its top, 10 times the band width. Coarsening does not move the rater component at all; only compilation does. THE RATER COMPONENT IS REAL AND MOVES: particular people are systematically worse served by the compiled rule across prompts, which is the measured form of the question earlier framed as whether a compiled decision overrides disagreement coherently patterned by an identifiable subgroup -- reached here with no new subjects, no leave-one-out, no exclusion of anyone's own input, and no dependence on the presentation-order field CoVal does not record. CONTROLS. Rebuild: this file recomputes the ledger's one-way rho to within 0.002, which matters because the round that first produced those numbers shipped no code and could not be put through the reproducibility gate at all. Positive: a planted per-rater offset is recovered monotonically across swept sizes, so a null here is a measurement rather than silence. Complementary, and it is the load-bearing one: shuffling RATER IDENTITIES WITHIN PROMPT preserves the case component and the marginal error distribution exactly while destroying real rater structure, and the observed var_rater is judged against that floor -- because estimated effects always have positive variance and that arithmetic is not evidence. SCOPE, stated rather than discovered later: CoVal is fully crossed, so the rater MAIN EFFECT is identified, but there is NO within-cell replication, so the rater-by-prompt INTERACTION cannot be separated from error and a test-retest reliability remains unidentified. Both arms are scored at EQUAL weights, because r04 gave core a weight of literally None and full the mean human rating, so its arms confounded compilation with the presence of ratings.
